Examples.Title: image-to-image
Examples.Description: Modify an image based on a text prompt
Examples.Code:
### image-to-image # @name imageToImage POST {{host}}/v1/generation/{{engine_id}}/image-to-image Authorization: Bearer {{token}} Accept: application/json Organization: org-123456 Content-Type: multipart/form-data Accept: application/json, image/png {"image_strength":0.35,"init_image_mode":"IMAGE_STRENGTH","init_image":"\u003Cimage binary\u003E","text_prompts[0][text]":"A dog space commander","text_prompts[0][weight]":1,"cfg_scale":7,"clip_guidance_preset":"FAST_BLUE","sampler":"K_DPM_2_ANCESTRAL","samples":3,"steps":20} ## Responses # 200 # Description: OK response. # Content-Type: application/json, image/png # 400 # Description: bad_request: general error for invalid parameters

More specific errors:

- invalid_samples: Sample count may only be greater than 1 when the accept header is set to `application/json` - invalid_height_or_width: Height and width must be specified in increments of 64 - invalid_file_size: The file size of one or more of the provided files is invalid - invalid_mime_type: The mime type of one or more of the provided files is invalid - invalid_image_dimensions: The dimensions of the provided `init_image` and `mask_image` do not match - invalid_mask_image: The parameter `mask_source` was set to `MASK_IMAGE_WHITE` or `MASK_IMAGE_BLACK` but no `mask_image` was provided - invalid_prompts: One or more of the prompts contains filtered words - invalid_pixel_count: Incorrect number of pixels specified. Requirements: - For 768 engines : 589,824 ≤ `height * width` ≤ 1,048,576 - All other engines: 262,144 ≤ `height * width` ≤ 1,048,576 # Content-Type: application/json # 401 # Description: unauthorized: API key missing or invalid # Content-Type: application/json # 403 # Description: permission_denied: You lack the necessary permissions to perform this action # Content-Type: application/json # 404 # Description: not_found: The requested resource was not found (e.g. specifing a model that does not exist) # Content-Type: application/json # 500 # Description: server_error: Some unexpected server error occurred # Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: image-to-image/upscale
Examples.Description:
Create a higher resolution version of an input image.

This operation outputs an image with a maximum pixel count of **4,194,304**. This is equivalent to dimensions such as `2048x2048` and `4096x1024`.

By default, the input image will be upscaled by a factor of 2.  For additional control over the output dimensions, a `width` or `height` parameter may be specified.
Examples.Code:
### image-to-image/upscale # @name upscaleImage POST {{host}}/v1/generation/{{engine_id}}/image-to-image/upscale Authorization: Bearer {{token}} Accept: application/json Organization: org-123456 Content-Type: multipart/form-data Accept: application/json, image/png {"image":"\u003Cimage binary\u003E"} ## Responses # 200 # Description: OK response. # Content-Type: application/json, image/png # 400 # Description: bad_request: general error for invalid parameters

More specific errors:

- invalid_file_size: The file size of one or more of the provided files is invalid - invalid_mime_type: The mime type of one or more of the provided files is invalid - invalid_pixel_count: The requested image would exceed the maximum pixel count of 4,194,304 # Content-Type: application/json # 401 # Description: unauthorized: API key missing or invalid # Content-Type: application/json # 403 # Description: permission_denied: You lack the necessary permissions to perform this action # Content-Type: application/json # 404 # Description: not_found: The requested resource was not found (e.g. specifing a model that does not exist) # Content-Type: application/json # 500 # Description: server_error: Some unexpected server error occurred # Content-Type: application/json
